record_type_quote: We attempted to replicate a claim from the 2009 Psychological Science article "Asymmetrical Body Perception: A Possible Role for Neural Body Representations".

targets.authors: Linkenauger, S. A., Witt, J. K., Bakdash, J. Z., Stefanucci, J. K., & Proffitt, D. R.
targets.title: Asymmetrical body perception: A possible role for neural body representations.
targets.evidence_quote: In particular, our replication focused on the Experiment 1 claim that right-handed people perceive their left and right arms to be different lengths, but in contrast, because left-handed people have nearly equal-sized cortical representations for their left and right arms, they perceive the lengths of their right and left arms as similar.
targets.outcome_quote: Thus, this replication of the claim was not successful according to the SCORE criteria.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The report states an overall unsuccessful replication verdict.

reasoning: Completed new-data direct replication; the report identifies the authors/team, original article, Experiment 1 and final results. Incidental rerunning of original analyses supports the replication workflow.
